content: प्रणिधिः .²1 Observing, spying out. .²2 Sending out spies. .²3 A spy, an emissary; अध्यापितस्योशनसापि नीतिं प्रयुक्तरागप्रणिधिर्द्विषस्ते <ls>Ku. 3. 6</ls>; <ls>R. 17. 48</ls>; <ls>Ms. 7. 153</ls>, <ls n="Ms.">8. 182</ls>. .²4 An attendant, a follower. .²5 Care, attention. .²6 Solicitation, entreaty, request; ‘प्रणिधिः प्रार्थने चरे’ <ls>Yādava.</ls> .²7 A method of driving an elephant; <ls>Mātaṅga L. 12. 6. 8</ls>. (There are three kinds of प्रणिधिs: by speech, feet and look.)
